question: What supports the cosmic egg and how is that support described by the teachers?
premises: There is a support of the cosmic egg.
It supports the egg on all sides by its own inherent power.
The teachers in the Raurava and other scriptures describe it as having the nature of the egg.
inference: The cosmic egg is upheld by a self-powered support that is itself egg-like in nature, according to authoritative teachers.
plain_english: That which supports the cosmic egg does so on all sides by its own power; the teachers in the Raurava and other scriptures declare it to be of the same nature as the egg.
